message: Production CUDA thermal/PTE, fixed-Maxwell-Q thermal-material AD-FD, and the exact thermal-to-native component-Yee pullback have passed. The pullback uses the transpose of the same material-intersection deposition as the forward source; the worst Qx/Qy/Qz transpose dot error is 4.097e-15, the Cauchy-normalized objective identity error is 5.104e-14, and no gradient rescaling was used. The centered rho=0.5 current remains an explicitly near-null diagnostic. Combined Maxwell AD-FD and design-window selection still block optimization.
